# Independent method review — issue #146

Recommendation: revise at a595009cb28eb5c3895e221f87a6a5dc04f95dd4.
Reviewed protocol introduction: cf38154ea947b34a66494f66a6d3353c32428c50 against parent d588fa96e0db384b29812bbab9dfa5d69ab78b1e; protocol unchanged at reviewed HEAD.
`git rev-parse HEAD` exited 0; `python3 -I policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` exited 0.
Actual check: benchmark_executed=false, benchmark_ready=false, tool_quality=null; missing tasks/oracle/split/baseline/challenges; errors=[], evidence_references=8, manifest=indexed. This checks index integrity, not method quality.

## Standards
No documented violation found within the permitted context; no broader repository audit performed. Candidate and evaluator were not edited.

## Spec
S1 (medium): [tasks lines 26–30, baseline lines 72–76, challenges lines 85–92](../benchmark/protocol.md#tasks) do not require a frozen scoring rubric for selective omissions, extra/duplicate claims or contradictions; scorers could disagree or reward incomplete exports. Require independent reference inventories, fixed dimension-level outcome rules and discriminating fixtures before comparative runs.
The remaining design addresses separate fidelity/correctness/grounding, independent native keys, whole-project/family isolation, matched baselines, required negative challenges and positive controls; [detailed section assessment and correction](artifacts/protocol-review.md).
All seven resource rows were checked against accepted limits: capability templates still need actual resources/materials/providers and concrete grant terms; ordinary public review is already orderable. [Row-by-row readiness assessment](artifacts/protocol-review.md#resource-table-readiness-against-accepted-limits); no requests filed.
Unchecked: native execution, key validation, variant analysis, actual isolation, challenge discrimination, model comparisons, costs and scorer verification. Missing families/versions remain coverage gaps; quality is unmeasured. This review authorizes no implementation or readiness claim.

## What next
Policymaker: order the targeted S1 revision and review its pinned commit, continue public preparation, and develop concrete native-job and restricted-store/case proposals. Detailed evidence and resume instructions are saved in [protocol-review.md](artifacts/protocol-review.md); avoid repeating source research or treating index exit 0 as benchmark success.
